title: wslua: Debugger: Editable Lua script editor
description:
Turn the Lua debugger’s script pane into a small editor: you can edit
plugins in place, search and replace text, and jump to a line number.

Unsaved changes are handled when you close the debugger, close a tab,
reload plugins from the debugger, or reload plugins from elsewhere—
with prompts to save, discard, or cancel where it matters.

Ping #21193

AI-Assisted: yes
